{{Quote|First step?''"<br />"''My quarters. I have notes on my datapad. And from now on, we should carry our notes on us at all times. If the healing crystals are vulnerable, so are we.|Tahl and Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="JA:TUP" />}}
'''Qui-Gon's quarters''' were the private quarters of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. They were located at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="JA:TUP" />
